summary: Exited at +8.50pts (t=18m) on a KMDR+PROPP against-fire confluence at a fresh episode high, the same paired signature that preceded the frame-3 pullback, combined with giveback spiking past 100% of the local leg's amplitude. Spent most of the trade chopping in a 0-6pt favorable band with very low ER10 (0.02-0.3), so the exit call was really about protecting a rare, clean push above +8 rather than reacting to any single feature. Next time I'd watch whether KMDR-against alone (without PROPP corroborating) is enough to act on sooner, and whether giveback-vs-amp ratio crossing 100% is itself a cleaner standalone trigger than waiting for two named fires to align.
